mainPage.title: DudaHero: Where Tradition Meets Innovation
mainPage.subtitle: The app to learn how to play bagpipes. No music theory is needed anymore.
mainPage.aims: Duda Hero aims to solve the challenge of finding a bagpipe teacher, especially for less common types of bagpipes.
mainPage.bagpipes: The next types of bagpipes are available to learn:
mainPage.other: Other bagpipes types are in development!
mainPage.melodies: Now in the app you can find tutorials for at least 120 folk melodies from different countries, sorted by country of origin.

login.reminderText: Logging in will help you save your settings, language, instrument type, tuning, and open the last played song on start. In the future, you will be able to write comments and see other users' playing progress and experience.

aboutPage.heroSubtitle: The app to learn how to play bagpipes. No music theory is needed anymore.
aboutPage.sectionTitle: Like Guitar Hero, but for bagpipes
aboutPage.description1: Duda Hero revolutionizes bagpipe learning by making it accessible to everyone. No more searching for specialized teachers - we bring the expertise to you!
aboutPage.moreComing: More bagpipe types coming soon! We're constantly expanding our collection.
aboutPage.discoverMelodies: Discover over {{count}} folk melodies from around the world, carefully curated and organized by their cultural origins.
aboutPage.myMelodiesText: Have a tune in your head? Write it in ABC notation, save it and play it with the bagpipe fingering. You can share a link to it with friends.

flutePage.heroSubtitle: Learn to play the tin whistle, sopilka and recorder. No music theory needed.
flutePage.sectionTitle: Like Guitar Hero, but for flutes
flutePage.description: Follow the animated fingering while the melody plays, slow it down, loop the hard bars and practise at your own pace. Your Duda Hero account works here too.
